newsitem.title: FRANCE: Large Saudi contract underpins French barley.
newsitem.headline: Large Saudi contract underpins French barley.

text.p: French barley prices firmed on Tuesday following news Saudi Arabia bought about 1.4 million tonnes of barley for import from October to December, dealers said.
The purchase, which has yet to be officially confirmed, was made at prices ranging from $146 to $158 per tonne, including cost and freight.
Barley into Rouen for October-December delivery was quoted at 880 francs per tonne, up ten francs on Monday.
Barley into Dunkirk for the same delivery periods fetched 885 francs, also up ten francs on the previous day.
The European Union, which enjoys a supply and freight advantage over other suppliers, is widely expected to help cover a large share of the contract, dealers said. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
